slate_quests.adv.title: Advancements to quests
slate_quests.adv.open.tip: Make chapters of the game's advancement trees (dev mode)
slate_quests.adv.all: Tick every tree in the list
slate_quests.adv.refresh.tip: Ask the server for its advancement trees again (after a datapack reload)
slate_quests.adv.next.tip: Choose what the chapters are like and see them before they are made
slate_quests.adv.undo.tip: Take the last conversion back (%s chapters). In the book's editor, Ctrl+Z does the same.
slate_quests.adv.undone.body: The book stands as it stood before.
slate_quests.adv.undone.n: %s chapters: the book stands as it stood before.
slate_quests.adv.empty: This game has no advancement trees
slate_quests.adv.chosen.none: %s trees. Tick the ones to convert.
slate_quests.adv.in_book.tip: In the book as the chapter %s
slate_quests.adv.hidden: %s of them hide until they are made
slate_quests.adv.state.loading: Asking the server for its advancement trees...
slate_quests.adv.state.no_world.body: Advancement trees come with a world's datapacks and mods. Open a world, then come back here.
slate_quests.adv.state.no_server.body: The server has no Slate Quests, or one from before this tool. The trees are read there, where their criteria and rewards are.
slate_quests.adv.state.no_permission.bod: Only those who may edit the quest book can make chapters of advancement trees.
slate_quests.adv.state.failed: The server could not list its trees
slate_quests.adv.state.failed.body: Its log says why. Ask again with the button above.
slate_quests.adv.state.no_tree.body: None of the game's advancement trees goes by that name.
slate_quests.adv.opt.id.tip: The chapter's id and file name: lower case letters, digits and _ - . Empty takes the one shown.
slate_quests.adv.opt.name: Name
slate_quests.adv.opt.name.tip: What the chapter is called. Empty takes the tree's own name.
slate_quests.adv.opt.group.tip: The group the chapters are listed under in the book
slate_quests.adv.opt.exists.tip: The book has a chapter of this id already
slate_quests.adv.opt.exists.none: No chapter of this id is in the book yet
slate_quests.adv.opt.exists.merge.tip: Quests are matched by id. What was edited in the book stays, the rest takes the new conversion's word.
slate_quests.adv.opt.exists.replace.tip: The new conversion takes the chapter's place
slate_quests.adv.opt.exists.copy.tip: A new chapter beside it, under an id that is free
slate_quests.adv.opt.tasks.translate.tip: A task for every criterion a task can say the same as (an item held, a mob killed, a place entered...). What none can say stays the advancement's.
slate_quests.adv.opt.tasks.advancement.t: Every quest has one task: the advancement is made
slate_quests.adv.opt.order.tree.tip: A quest opens when the one before it in the tree is done
slate_quests.adv.opt.order.free.tip: Every quest is open from the start, as the game's advancements are; the lines only show the tree
slate_quests.adv.opt.kind.quest.tip: Ordinary quests in the book's shapes: a diamond for a goal, a star for a challenge. Rewards are claimed in the book.
slate_quests.adv.opt.kind.advancement.ti: Quests that behave as advancements do: the player's own, in the game's frames, announced in chat, rewards at once
slate_quests.adv.opt.names.keys.tip: Titles and texts stay translation keys: every player reads them in their own language
slate_quests.adv.opt.names.words.tip: Titles and texts are written out as the server reads them, to be edited as text
slate_quests.adv.opt.spacing.tip: How far apart neighbours stand, in the book's units: 1 is the game's own, 1.5 the book's
slate_quests.adv.opt.rewards.tip: The advancement's own rewards (experience, loot, recipes, a function) become the quest's. Off by default: the game still gives its own when the advancement is made, so on, a player is paid twice.
slate_quests.adv.convert.tip: Make the chapters and open the first in the editor (Ctrl+Enter)
slate_quests.adv.done.body: %s kept the advancement as their task. Ctrl+Z takes the conversion back.
slate_quests.adv.done.body.none: Every quest has tasks of its own. Ctrl+Z takes the conversion back.
slate_quests.adv.mode.replaced: Takes the place of the chapter %s
slate_quests.adv.mode.merged: Merges into %s: %s new, %s updated, %s kept as edited, %s gone
slate_quests.adv.mode.copy: A copy beside the one that is there, as %s
slate_quests.adv.why.off: the advancement is its task, as chosen
slate_quests.adv.why.trigger: keeps the advancement (no task says the same)
slate_quests.adv.why.requirements: keeps the advancement (one of each of several groups)
slate_quests.adv.why.too_many: keeps the advancement (more than a quest holds)
slate_quests.adv.why.unreadable: keeps the advancement (the server cannot read what it asks)
slate_quests.adv.why.no_criteria: keeps the advancement (only a command makes it)
slate_quests.adv.result.nothing_to_undo: There is no conversion to take back.
slate_quests.adv.result.edited_since: The chapter %s was changed since it was converted: it is not taken back. Undo there first.
slate_quests.adv.result.bad_id: "%s" cannot be an id: lower case letters, digits and _ - . only.
slate_quests.adv.result.id_twice: Two trees would become the chapter %s.
slate_quests.adv.result.too_big: That is more than the server can send at once. Take fewer trees, or a smaller one.
slate_quests.adv.command.word: "%s" is not one of the choices. They are: tasks=translate|advancement, order=tree|free, kind=quest|advancement, rewards=true, names=words, spacing=<1 to 3>, group=<id>, exists=replace|merge|copy, id=<chapter id>.
slate_quests.adv.command.one_id: id= names the chapter of one tree, and "%s" is %s trees.
slate_quests.adv.command.done: Converted: %s chapter(s), %s quests. "/slatequests convert undo" takes it back.
slate_quests.adv.command.account: %s is the chapter %s (%s): %s quests, %s with tasks of their own, %s partly, %s kept the advancement.
slate_quests.adv.command.account.merged: Merged: %s quests added, %s fields brought up, %s kept as edited, %s quests gone. %s
slate_quests.adv.command.list.none: This game has no advancement trees.
slate_quests.adv.command.undone: The last conversion was taken back (%s chapter(s)).
slate_quests.editor.switch.off.tip: Edit the quest book: move quests, link them, change everything about them. (Ctrl+E)
slate_quests.editor.switch.on.tip: Stop editing and read the book again. (Ctrl+E)
slate_quests.editor.switch.readonly: These are the game's own advancements. The game keeps them: they cannot be edited here.
slate_quests.editor.switch.elsewhere: Edit the quest book. The editor works on the flat tree: it opens there, on this chapter.
slate_quests.editor.strip.tip: Every change goes to the server as it is made, and each can be taken back (Ctrl+Z).
slate_quests.editor.busy: One moment: the server is renaming
slate_quests.editor.hint.rim: Pull a line from here: onto a quest to make it wait for this one, onto the ground for a new quest that does.
slate_quests.editor.hint.line: The second quest waits for the first. Click to choose the line, Delete to remove it.
slate_quests.editor.hint.gateway: A way in. Click twice to step into its tree.
slate_quests.editor.link.exists: It waits for that one already
slate_quests.editor.link.self: A quest cannot wait for itself
slate_quests.editor.delete.title: Delete?
slate_quests.editor.delete.waiting.one: One quest waits for it, and will wait no longer.
slate_quests.editor.delete.waiting: %s quests wait for what goes, and will wait no longer.
slate_quests.editor.delete.tree: A tree hangs on it: the tree stays, without a way in.
slate_quests.editor.tool.snap: Snap quests to the grid as they are dragged. Alt turns it round for one drag.
slate_quests.editor.tool.add: Add a quest, a label, a picture, a chapter
slate_quests.editor.tab.chapter.tip: The chapter shown: its name, its look, what opens it.
slate_quests.editor.tab.book.tip: The whole book: its name, its groups, every chapter.
slate_quests.editor.subject.label: Label
slate_quests.editor.subject.decoration.s: On the ground of the tree
slate_quests.editor.subject.book.sub: Its name, its groups, its chapters
slate_quests.editor.menu.tree.make: Give it a tree of its own
slate_quests.editor.f.title: Name
slate_quests.editor.f.title.tip: What the quest is called. Left empty, it is called after what its first task asks for.
slate_quests.editor.f.subtitle: Line under it
slate_quests.editor.f.icon.tip: The picture in the node: an item, a #tag, icon:<glyph> or texture:<id>. Left empty: what the first task asks for.
slate_quests.editor.f.size.tip: How large the node is against an ordinary one. Milestones are larger, optional quests smaller.
slate_quests.editor.f.frame.tip: Task, goal or challenge: how loudly the quest is celebrated, and for an advancement quest the frame it stands in.
slate_quests.editor.f.kind.tip: An advancement quest behaves as the game's advancements do: the player's own, announced in chat, its rewards handed out at once.
slate_quests.editor.f.anyTask.tip: One finished task finishes the quest. Otherwise all of them must be.
slate_quests.editor.f.autoClaim.tip: The rewards are handed over the moment the quest is done, without the player claiming them.
slate_quests.editor.f.depMode.tip: All of the quests it waits for, or only some of them.
slate_quests.editor.f.minDeps.tip: How many of the quests it waits for must be done.
slate_quests.editor.f.hideLines.tip: Leave out the lines from what it waits for. They still count.
slate_quests.editor.f.looseDeps.tip: The lines only say where the quest stands in the tree: it is open whether or not what it waits for is done.
slate_quests.editor.f.inline.tip: As a tab: the quest is a way in, and its tree has a tab of its own. Inside this tree: a click on the quest unfolds its tree under it, and what stands lower moves down to make room. The islands show either kind as a way in. While editing, both are worked on as trees of their own.
slate_quests.editor.f.sync.tip: Whose progress it is: the team's (done for all of them), or each player's own.
slate_quests.editor.f.visibility.tip: What shows while the quest is locked: itself, a question mark (secret), or nothing at all (hidden).
slate_quests.editor.f.optional.tip: Does not count towards finishing the chapter.
slate_quests.editor.f.repeatable.tip: It can be done again, each time for its rewards.
slate_quests.editor.f.cooldownSeconds.ti: How long it rests before it opens again.
slate_quests.editor.f.silent.tip: No toast when it is done: for a quest that only marks a step.
slate_quests.editor.f.teamXp.tip: Experience for the team when it is done (Slate Teams). -1 takes the server's default.
slate_quests.editor.f.tags.tip: Words the search finds the quest by, beside its name and text. Commas between them.
slate_quests.editor.f.x.tip: Where the middle stands, in units of the tree.
slate_quests.editor.f.y.tip: Where the middle stands, in units of the tree. Y grows downwards.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.title: Name
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.subtitle: Line under it
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.subtitle.t: A line under the name, shown beside the tabs.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.icon.tip: The chapter's picture in the list.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.group.tip: The group the chapter is listed under. The book's own properties have the groups.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.parent.tip: This is a tree within a quest of that chapter. Click to go there.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.accent.tip: The chapter's own colour: rings, lines, its banner. None: the theme's.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.backdrop.t: What lies behind the tree: one of the named grounds, or any block's texture.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.texture.ti: The texture the ground is tiled with (minecraft:block/deepslate).
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.shape.tip: The outline of the chapter's nodes, unless a quest has its own.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.sync.tip: Whose progress the chapter's quests are, unless a quest says otherwise.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.hidden.tip: Leave the chapter out of the list until it opens. Otherwise it is listed, locked.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.requires.t: Quests of any chapter that must be done before this chapter opens.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.id.tip: The chapter's id is its file's name. Click to rename it: progress and everything that names the chapter follow.
slate_quests.editor.f.book.title: Name
slate_quests.editor.f.book.subtitle: Line under it
slate_quests.editor.f.book.subtitle.tip: A line under the book's name.
Offer the game's own advancements as a last group of the book.
slate_quests.editor.f.group.title: Name
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.heading: Heading font
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.heading.tip: Draw the label in the heading font. A heading stays readable far out.
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.scale.tip: How large the words are against ordinary text.
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.color.tip: The colour of the words. None: the muted text colour.
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.w.tip: How wide the picture is, in units of the tree.
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.h.tip: How high the picture is, in units of the tree.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.type.tip: What kind of task it is. The rows under it are what that kind reads.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.item.tip: An item id or a #tag. What the stack has to be like can follow in brackets, as the game's commands write it.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.count.tip: The task counts up to this.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.consume.tip: It is taken from the player, with a button. Part payments count.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.advancement.t: The advancement the player must have.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.points.tip: Count experience points rather than levels.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.dimension.tip: The dimension to be in. Empty: any.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.biome.tip: The biome to be in. Empty: any.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.structure.tip: The structure to be in. Empty: any.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.radius.tip: How near to the place counts. 0: the place does not matter.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.seconds.tip: How long the player has to look at it.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.quest.tip: The quest that must be done, as chapter/quest.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.chapter.tip: The chapter whose quests must all be done (the optional ones aside).
slate_quests.editor.f.task.value.tip: What of the team is counted.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.name: Name
slate_quests.editor.f.task.name.tip: The name the task is done by: /slatequests task <players> <quest> <name>.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.title: Called
slate_quests.editor.f.task.title.tip: What the task is called in the quest's list. Left empty, it is put into words from what it asks.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.icon.tip: The task's own picture. Left empty: what it asks for.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.type.tip: What kind of reward it is. The rows under it are what that kind reads.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.item.tip: The item, as /give takes it: an id, with components in brackets.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.levels.tip: Give that many levels rather than points.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.command.tip: Run by the server. {player} and {team} are filled in.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.loot.tip: The loot table that is rolled.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.advancement: The advancement that is granted. A recipe is an advancement too.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.weight.tip: How likely this one is among the others.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.team.tip: Claimed once for the team, by whoever claims first. Otherwise each member claims it.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.title: Called
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.title.tip: What the reward is called in the quest's list. Left empty, it is put into words from what it gives.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.icon.tip: The reward's own picture. Left empty: what it gives.
slate_quests.editor.v.shape.chapter.name: The chapter's (%s)
slate_quests.editor.v.deco.label: Words
slate_quests.editor.v.align.centre: Line up on the middle, across
slate_quests.editor.v.align.middle: Line up on the middle, down
slate_quests.editor.v.task.team: The team's size, land or level
slate_quests.editor.v.reward.loot: A roll of a loot table
slate_quests.editor.id.invalid: Lower case letters, digits and _ - . only.
slate_quests.editor.tasks.none: No tasks: the quest is done the moment it opens.
slate_quests.editor.tasks.none.gateway: No tasks of its own: it is done when its tree is.
slate_quests.editor.task.stat.note: Statistics count in the game's own units: distances in centimetres, time in ticks. Say what it means in “Called”.
slate_quests.editor.task.location.note: Every row that is filled in must hold. A place counts only with a radius above 0.
slate_quests.editor.task.checkmark.note: The player ticks it off with a button. Say in “Called” what is to be done.
slate_quests.editor.task.team.note: Needs Slate Teams on the server. Without it the task can never be done.
slate_quests.editor.task.custom.note: Counted by a command or by another mod. The quest waits until that happens.
slate_quests.editor.reward.choice.new: A new one to choose from
slate_quests.editor.reward.choices.rando: The player gets one of, by weight
slate_quests.editor.reward.command.note: {player} is the player's name, {team} the team's. Give the reward a name: the player reads that, not the command.
slate_quests.editor.reward.team_xp.note: Experience for the team. Needs Slate Teams on the server.
slate_quests.editor.deps.none: It waits for nothing: it is open from the start.
slate_quests.editor.deps.add.tip: Pick a quest of any chapter. Within one tree a line pulled from quest to quest does the same.
slate_quests.editor.tree.none: A quest can hold a whole tree of its own. Pointing at it unfolds the tree; opening it steps inside.
slate_quests.editor.tree.remove: No longer a way in (the tree stays)
slate_quests.editor.tree.open.tip: Click to step into the tree.
slate_quests.editor.tree.note: The tree's quests open once this quest is open.
slate_quests.editor.tree.note.done: The tree's quests open once this quest is open. With no tasks of its own, the quest is done when its tree is.
slate_quests.editor.tree.made.body: “%s” is made. Click here to step inside.
slate_quests.editor.tree.circle: That chapter holds this one: it cannot hang under it.
slate_quests.editor.requires.none: Nothing: the chapter is open from the start.
slate_quests.editor.requires.none.tree: Nothing more: it opens with the quest that leads into it.
slate_quests.editor.chapter.new.tip: A new chapter, listed with the one shown.
slate_quests.editor.chapter.new.title: A new chapter
slate_quests.editor.chapter.new.body: What is the chapter called? Its file is named after it.
slate_quests.editor.chapter.rename.title: Rename the chapter's file
slate_quests.editor.chapter.rename.body: The id is the file's name: lower case letters, digits and _ - . Progress, and everything that names the chapter, follows.
slate_quests.editor.chapter.delete.title: Delete the chapter?
slate_quests.editor.chapter.delete.body: “%s” and its %s quests are deleted, here and in the server's files.
“%s” with its %s quests is deleted, and the %s trees within it, here and in the server's files.
slate_quests.editor.chapter.deleted.body: “%s” is gone. Click here to bring it back.
slate_quests.editor.quest.rename.title: Rename the quest's id
slate_quests.editor.quest.rename.body: Lower case letters, digits and _ - . Progress, and everything that names the quest, follows.
slate_quests.editor.groups.none: No groups: the chapters are listed one after another.
slate_quests.editor.groups.new.title: A new group
slate_quests.editor.groups.new.body: What is the group called? Chapters are put into it from their own properties.
slate_quests.editor.groups.row.tip: Click to change its name and picture.
slate_quests.editor.group.delete.title: Remove the group?
slate_quests.editor.group.delete.body: “%s” is removed. Its %s chapters stay, listed without a group.
slate_quests.editor.outline.none: No chapters yet. Make the first one.
slate_quests.editor.outline.row.tip: Click to go to this chapter.
slate_quests.editor.several.note: * they differ in this. A change sets it on all of them.
slate_quests.editor.several.labels: %s labels and pictures are chosen. They are moved, copied and deleted together.
slate_quests.editor.several.across.tip: The same distance from each to the next, between the leftmost and the rightmost.
slate_quests.editor.several.down.tip: The same distance from each to the next, between the topmost and the lowest.
slate_quests.editor.text.hint: A paragraph a line. **bold**, # Heading, - list, {item:id}
slate_quests.editor.text.open.tip: Opens the text beside the way the book shows it, with buttons for the marks.
slate_quests.editor.text.foot: A paragraph a line. Ctrl+Enter: done.
slate_quests.editor.text.letter.heading: H
slate_quests.editor.text.tool.heading: A heading: # at the start of the line
slate_quests.editor.text.tool.list: A list item: - at the start of the line
slate_quests.editor.text.tool.rule: A rule across: --- on a line of its own
slate_quests.editor.text.tool.item: An item with its picture and tooltip…
slate_quests.editor.text.tool.quest: A link that goes to a quest…
slate_quests.editor.pick.manual.tip: An id, a #tag, or an item with its components in brackets, as the book writes it.
slate_quests.editor.pick.use.tip: Take what is written, as it stands.
slate_quests.editor.pick.empty.item_tags: Tags belong to a world: they are known once one is joined. Write one by hand: #minecraft:logs
slate_quests.editor.pick.empty.block_tag: Tags belong to a world: they are known once one is joined. Write one by hand: #minecraft:base_stone_overworld
slate_quests.editor.pick.empty.mob_tags: Tags belong to a world: they are known once one is joined. Write one by hand: #minecraft:undead
slate_quests.editor.pick.empty.advanceme: Advancements belong to a world: they are known once one is joined. Write the id by hand: minecraft:story/mine_stone
slate_quests.editor.pick.empty.quests: The book has no quests yet.
slate_quests.editor.pick.empty.chapters: The book has no chapters yet.
slate_quests.ftb.converted: The FTB Quests book was converted into Slate's quest book: %s chapters, %s quests, %s tasks, %s rewards; %s things were approximated, %s need another mod. Report: %s
slate_quests.ftb.updated: The FTB Quests book had changed and was converted again: %s chapters, %s quests. What was edited in Slate's book was kept, and a backup of the book as it was. Report: %s
slate_quests.ftb.beside: An FTB Quests book was found and converted (%s chapters, %s quests), but this server has a quest book of its own, which was not touched. The conversion is in %s; "/slatequests import ftb install" makes it the server's book.
slate_quests.ftb.progress: Progress made in FTB Quests was carried over: %s teams and players, %s quests done; %s parties of FTB Teams became teams.
slate_quests.ftb.status.converted: The server's book is a conversion of it: %s chapters, %s quests, %s approximated, %s need another mod. Up to date: %s
slate_quests.ftb.status.beside: The server has a book of its own; the conversion is kept beside it in %s.
slate_quests.ftb.status.not: The server's book is not a conversion of an FTB Quests book.
slate_quests.ftb.status.mod: FTB Quests is %s. Converting by itself: %s. Carrying progress over: %s.
slate_quests.command.import.empty: The FTB Quests book in %s has no quests.
slate_quests.command.import.progress.no_: The server's quest book is not a converted FTB Quests book, so there is nothing to carry progress into.
slate_quests.command.import.progress.non: This world has no progress of FTB Quests (no ftbquests folder in it).
slate_quests.result.task_locked: The tasks of this quest are done in order: the one before it comes first.
slate_quests.result.missing_fluid: You carry none of that fluid (in buckets or tanks).
slate_quests.result.missing_energy: Nothing you carry holds energy to hand in.
slate_quests.result.no_energy_here: Nothing on this server can hold energy: this task needs a mod that has batteries.
slate_quests.result.emergency_wait: The emergency items can be had again in a while.
slate_quests.result.no_emergency: This book has no emergency items.
slate_quests.reward.currency.none: This reward is %s coins, but no mod on this server keeps money.
slate_quests.task.fluid.name: A fluid
slate_quests.task.energy.name: Energy
slate_quests.task.stage.name: A stage
slate_quests.task.counter.name: A counter
slate_quests.task.tip.filter: FTB Filter System reads this filter, and it is not installed: the task cannot be noticed here.
slate_quests.task.tip.optional: The quest is done without it.
slate_quests.task.how.fluid: Have it with you, in buckets or tanks: it is noticed by itself.
slate_quests.task.how.fluid.consume: Handed in with the button, from the buckets and tanks you carry: you keep the empty ones.
slate_quests.task.how.energy: Handed in with the button, from whatever you carry that holds energy.
slate_quests.task.how.stage: Done once you have the stage.
slate_quests.task.how.counter: Counts what rewards and the server add to it.
slate_quests.reward.tip.bonus: At least %s, at most %s: how many is left to chance.
slate_quests.reward.how.stage: Changes which stage you are at.
slate_quests.reward.how.counter: Adds to a counter that other quests wait for.
slate_quests.reward.how.currency: Money, where a mod on the server keeps it.
slate_quests.sheet.sequential.tip: Its tasks are done one after the other, from the top.
slate_quests.sheet.details_hidden: What this quest asks and gives shows once it opens.
slate_quests.sheet.text_hidden: Its story is told once it is done.
slate_quests.sheet.guide.tip: The guide book's page on this: %s.
slate_quests.sheet.guide.missing: The guide book's page on this (%s). It needs Patchouli, which is not installed.
slate_quests.sheet.guide.failed: That page of the guide could not be opened
slate_quests.emergency.tip: For when you are stuck. Once every %s.
slate_quests.closed.body: On this server quests count without a book to open.
slate_quests.settings.ftbTakeover.tip: Only for a pack that still has FTB Quests installed (it is not needed: Slate reads its book files). With this server's book converted from it: FTB Quests' key and buttons open this book, and its toasts stay quiet. Off, FTB Quests is left alone.
slate_quests.editor.emergency.none: None. Add an item and the book's header offers it to players who are stuck.
slate_quests.editor.book.source.ftb: This book was converted from an FTB Quests book. When that book changes it is converted again, and what is edited here is kept.
slate_quests.editor.pick.empty.fluid_tag: Tags belong to a world: they are known once one is joined. Write one by hand: #minecraft:water
slate_quests.editor.task.box: Or a box from there, this large
slate_quests.editor.task.fluid.note: Buckets count a thousand each. Tanks of other mods count where the loader can read them.
slate_quests.editor.task.energy.note: Handed in from what the player carries that holds energy. Needs a mod that has batteries.
slate_quests.editor.task.stage.note: A tag on the player (/tag), or a stage of the mod that keeps stages where one is installed.
slate_quests.editor.task.counter.note: Counts what counter rewards and /slatequests counter add to it. The team shares it.
slate_quests.editor.reward.toast.note: A notice on the player's screen and nothing else. Its title is the name below.
slate_quests.editor.reward.stage.note: A tag on the player (/tag), or a stage of the mod that keeps stages where one is installed.
slate_quests.editor.reward.counter.note: Adds to a counter that counter tasks wait for.
slate_quests.editor.reward.currency.note: Money, where FTB Library and a mod that keeps money are installed. Elsewhere the player is told that there is none.
slate_quests.editor.reward.custom.note: Gives nothing by itself: another mod listens for it by this name.
slate_quests.editor.f.iconScale.tip: How large the picture in the node is against its usual size.
slate_quests.editor.f.sequential.tip: The tasks are done one after the other: one counts only once those before it are done.
slate_quests.editor.f.depsStarted.tip: What it waits for counts as soon as anything of it is done, not only once all of it is.
slate_quests.editor.f.hideOutLines.tip: Leave out the lines to the quests that wait for this one. They still count.
slate_quests.editor.f.maxDependents.tip: Of the quests that wait for this one only so many can be done; the others are shut for good. 0: all of them.
slate_quests.editor.f.revealTasks.tip: It shows itself once this many of its tasks are done. 0: only when all of it is.
slate_quests.editor.f.hideDetails.tip: While it is locked, its sheet says only what it waits for.
slate_quests.editor.f.hideText.tip: The quest's text is shown once the quest is done.
slate_quests.editor.f.guide.tip: A book of Patchouli and an entry of it (tfc:field_guide tfc:mechanics/bellows). The sheet opens it where Patchouli is installed.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.unlisted.t: The chapter is not in the list at all. Its quests count and reward like any others.
slate_quests.editor.f.chapter.focus.tip: The quest of this chapter the view goes to when the chapter is opened. None: the whole tree is fitted.
slate_quests.editor.f.book.closed.tip: Players cannot open the book: its quests count and reward behind the scenes. Those who may edit still can.
slate_quests.editor.f.book.emergencyCool: How long a player waits before the emergency items can be had again.
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.order.tip: Which lies over which: lower numbers are drawn first.
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.hover.tip: Lines shown when the pointer rests on it, with " | " between them.
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.link.tip: Where a click on it leads: a web address, a quest (chapter/quest) or a chapter (chapter:id).
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.requires.tip: The quest that has to be done before it shows. None: it always shows.
slate_quests.editor.f.deco.editorOnly.ti: Shown only while the editor is on.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.optional.tip: The quest is done without this task. It is still shown and counted.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.mobname.tip: Only mobs that go by this name count (a name tag, a boss). Empty: any of the kind.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.criterion.tip: One criterion of the advancement is enough. Empty: the whole advancement.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.sizeX.tip: How many blocks the box reaches from the place, east.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.sizeY.tip: How many blocks the box reaches from the place, up.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.sizeZ.tip: How many blocks the box reaches from the place, south.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.fluid.tip: The fluid's id, or a tag with # before it.
How much of it. A bucket is 1000.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.stage.tip: The stage the player has to have.
slate_quests.editor.f.task.counter.tip: The name of the counter this task waits for.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.bonus.tip: Up to this many more are handed over, how many is left to chance.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.level.tip: The level the command runs with. 0: the level of those who may edit the book. Never more than that from here.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.said.tip: A line for the player's chat once the command has run.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.empty.tip: How likely a draw gives nothing, as a weight beside the others.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.criterion.t: Only this criterion of the advancement is granted. Empty: all of it.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.text.tip: What the notice says under its title.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.remove.tip: The player loses the stage instead of getting it.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.counter.tip: The name of the counter this adds to.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.name: Name
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.name.tip: The name another mod knows this reward by.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.auto.tip: The player gets it the moment the quest is done, without claiming.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.hidden.tip: The reward is not shown among the quest's rewards, and handed over at once.
slate_quests.editor.f.reward.excluded.ti: "Claim all" leaves it: it is claimed on its own quest only.
slate_quests.editor.v.visibility.follow: Itself, once what it waits for shows
slate_quests.result.no_such_task: That quest has no such task.
slate_quests.result.write_failed: The server could not write the quest book to disk; see its log.
slate_quests.command.reloaded: The quest book was read again: %s chapters, %s quests.
slate_quests.command.open.none: None of them has Slate Quests on their client.
slate_quests.command.import.started: Reading the FTB Quests book in %s ...
slate_quests.command.import.none: No FTB Quests book was found in %s (its chapters folder is missing).
slate_quests.command.import.done: Converted %s chapters with %s quests into %s. %s things were approximated: see ftb-report.txt there. Look it over; "/slatequests import ftb install" makes the FTB Quests book the server's book.

slate_quests.result.not_implemented: The server cannot do that yet.
slate_quests.result.unknown: The server does not know that action.
slate_quests.result.no_permission: Only operators may change the quest book.
slate_quests.result.not_done: The quest is not done yet.
slate_quests.result.not_open: The quest is not open yet.
slate_quests.result.choose: Choose one of the rewards first.
slate_quests.result.missing_items: You do not have what the task asks for: %s more.
slate_quests.result.missing_xp: You do not have that much experience.
slate_quests.result.invalid: The server could not read that.
slate_quests.card.secret: It keeps itself secret until it opens.
slate_quests.card.hint.tree: Click to open · twice to step inside
slate_quests.card.hint.unfold: Click to unfold · twice to open
slate_quests.card.hint.fold: Click to fold · twice to open
slate_quests.inline.open.tip: Opens the quest's tree under it, right here in the chapter. A click on the quest does the same.
slate_quests.inline.fold.tip: Folds the quest's tree away again. A click on the quest does the same.
slate_quests.view.tree.name: Tree
slate_quests.view.islands.name: Islands
slate_quests.view.tree: Show the book as a tree (V)
slate_quests.view.busy: The other view is there again once editing is switched off.
slate_quests.rail.locked: Not open yet. It opens after:
slate_quests.sheet.sync.team: Your team works on this together: it is done for all of you.
slate_quests.sheet.sync.player: This one is yours alone: it is not shared with your team.
slate_quests.sheet.advancement: An advancement: announced when it is made, its rewards handed out at once.
slate_quests.sheet.optional.tip: Does not count towards finishing the chapter.
slate_quests.sheet.repeatable.tip: Can be done again, each time for its rewards.
slate_quests.sheet.repeatable.rest: Can be done again, each time for its rewards, after resting %s.
slate_quests.sheet.auto_claim.tip: The rewards are handed out the moment the quest is done.
slate_quests.sheet.tree_locked: Its tree opens once this quest is open.
slate_quests.task.tick.tip: Tick this off when you have done it.
slate_quests.task.submit.tip: Hand it in: it is taken from you.
slate_quests.sheet.choose.title: Choose one
slate_quests.task.how.have: Have it with you: it is noticed by itself.
slate_quests.task.how.consume: Handed in with the button: it is taken from you.
slate_quests.task.how.craft: Make it yourself: crafting, smelting and the like count.
slate_quests.task.how.kill: Counted as you (or your pet, or your arrow) kill them.
slate_quests.task.how.advancement: Done once you have the advancement.
slate_quests.task.how.observe: Keep looking at it until the bar is full.
slate_quests.task.how.custom: Done by the server when its time comes.
slate_quests.reward.how.loot: A roll of a loot table.
slate_quests.reward.how.random: You get one of these, by chance.
slate_quests.claim_all.tip: Claims the rewards of the one quest that is done.
slate_quests.claim_all.tip.count: Claims the rewards of all %s quests that are done.
slate_quests.claim_all.done.one: The rewards of 1 quest are yours.
slate_quests.claim_all.done.many: The rewards of %s quests are yours.
slate_quests.claim_all.pick.one: One waiting reward lets you pick one of several. Confirm, and Claim all picks it for you.
slate_quests.claim_all.pick.many: %s waiting rewards let you pick one of several. Confirm, and Claim all picks them for you.
slate_quests.filter.tip: What of the tree stands out; the rest is dimmed.
slate_quests.menu.reset.title: Reset this quest?
slate_quests.menu.reset.body: The progress of “%s” is thrown away, the rewards claimed for it stay claimed. This cannot be undone.
slate_quests.keys.title: Finding your way
slate_quests.keys.tab: Tab  ·  the next quest to do
slate_quests.keys.fold: Click a quest marked +  ·  unfold its tree
slate_quests.keys.esc: Esc  ·  close the sheet, then the book
slate_quests.state.no_server.title: No quest book here
slate_quests.state.no_server.body: This server does not run Slate Quests, or has not sent its book yet. Nothing is wrong on your side: there is simply no book to open.
slate_quests.state.no_world.title: No quest book yet
slate_quests.state.no_world.body: The book belongs to a world. Join one, and its quests are here.
slate_quests.state.empty.title: An empty book
slate_quests.state.empty.body: This book has no chapters yet. Whoever runs the server can write them, in the game or as files in config/slate/quests.
slate_quests.settings.section.tracker.ab: The pinned quests and their open tasks, at a corner of the screen while you play.
slate_quests.settings.section.notices.ab: What is said when a quest or a chapter is done.
slate_quests.settings.section.book.about: How the tree of a chapter behaves, and where the book can be opened from.
slate_quests.settings.tracker.tip: Pinned quests with their tasks and bars while you play. Pin a quest from its sheet, or with a right click in the tree.
slate_quests.settings.trackerAnchor.tip: The corner of the screen the tracker is measured from.
slate_quests.settings.trackerX.tip: In pixels of the screen, from the corner's side edge.
slate_quests.settings.trackerY: Distance from the top or bottom
slate_quests.settings.trackerY.tip: In pixels of the screen, from the corner's upper or lower edge.
slate_quests.settings.trackerScale.tip: How large the tracker is drawn.
slate_quests.settings.trackerMax.tip: The most quests the tracker shows at once.
slate_quests.settings.trackerAuto.tip: A quest is pinned when its first task makes progress, while there is room in the tracker.
slate_quests.settings.toasts.tip: A notice when a quest is done, yours or a teammate's. A click on it opens the book on that quest.
slate_quests.settings.chapterBanner.tip: A banner across the top of the screen when a chapter is finished.
slate_quests.settings.celebrations.tip: The ring that runs out from a quest that opens, and the sparks of one that is done.
slate_quests.settings.sounds.tip: A sound for goals, challenges and finished chapters.
slate_quests.settings.flowingLines.tip: The lines between quests carry a current towards what can be done next.
slate_quests.settings.subtreePreview.tip: Pointing at a quest that has a tree of its own unfolds that tree beside it.
slate_quests.settings.subtreePreviewDela: How long the pointer rests on such a quest before its tree unfolds.
slate_quests.settings.zoomToPointer.tip: The wheel zooms towards where the pointer is; off, towards the middle of the tree.
slate_quests.settings.turnTallTrees: Turn tall trees on their side
slate_quests.settings.turnTallTrees.tip: A chapter much taller than wide, too large to read whole, is drawn left to right instead of top to bottom, so more of it fits on the screen. Only the drawing turns: the book stays as written, and the editor shows it that way.
slate_quests.settings.overview.tip: A small picture of the whole tree in a corner of it, while the tree is larger than what is in view. Drag in it to move the view.
slate_quests.settings.dimCompleted.tip: Quests that are done are drawn fainter, so what is left stands out.
slate_quests.settings.inventoryButton.ti: A button in the row above the inventory that opens the quest book, with a dot while rewards wait.
slate_quests.settings.advancements.tip: Shows the game's own advancements as chapters of the book, where the server's book asks for them.
slate_quests.vanilla.tabs.again: Click again to read about it
slate_quests.vanilla.edit.tip: Opens this chapter in the editor.
slate_quests.vanilla.edit.readonly: The game's own advancements cannot be edited.
slate_quests.vanilla.keys.groups: Ctrl + Page Up, Page Down  ·  groups of chapters
slate_quests.vanilla.keys.esc: Esc  ·  close the page, then the book
slate_quests.vanilla.pin.tip: Keeps this quest and its open tasks on the screen while you play.
slate_quests.vanilla.unpin.tip: Takes it off the tracker again.
slate_quests.vanilla.page.tree: Holds the quest tree “%s”: %s of %s done.
